scope.flow: Router swap functions execute without a deadline parameter, so a pending swap transaction can be executed after the user's intended time window has passed
scope.environment: Ekubo Router contract (Router.sol swap functions and swapParameters.sol packed struct)

statements.text: None of the Router swap functions include a deadline parameter, and the SwapParameters packed struct also lacks a deadline field, so no timestamp bound is validated on execution.
A user submits a swap intending it to execute only within a bounded time window ("within the next N minutes, or don't execute it at all").
A submitted swap transaction remains pending and is not yet executed, e.g. due to network congestion or delay.
The pending swap transaction is executed after the user's intended time window has passed.
A swap submitted with a deadline must revert if executed after that deadline timestamp has passed.
A swap transaction must not be executable outside the user's expressed time window.

ambiguities: Report does not state an explicit attacker actor or permissionless caller; MEV extraction is described only as a scenario.
No concrete transaction, timestamp, or observed execution is provided; the stale-execution scenario is conditional.
The report does not establish a specific prior on-chain state (e.g. a particular pending tx) beyond the general scenario description.
No harmful outcome is expressly stated in the supplied Impact-area fragments; they describe the missing deadline parameter and its purpose but do not state a resulting harm.
